pr.title: feat(cli): add --from-path to nav commands so cd can follow a branch
pr.body: In a worktree-per-branch layout, moving up the stack is a `cd`, not a checkout - and a program cannot change its parent shell's directory. `--from-path` prints where to go and lets a shell function do the moving; the README carries the snippet. For a branch that lives here it checks out and prints `.`, so your current directory is left alone. For one in another worktree it prints that path without moving anything. Without the flag a collision stays an error - there is nothing the caller can act on, and exiting 0 would tell a script the branch changed when it did not. Closes #281 - 🟣 ~~[fix(sync): skip a trunk fetch and a landing checkout another worktree blocks (#295)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/295)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[docs(guide): add a worktrees tour covering the flows and gotchas (#294)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/294)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): add new --worktree, with git-stk owning the worktrees it creates (#293)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/293)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(run): run in a scratch worktree by default, with --no-worktree to opt out (#292)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/292)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): add --from-path to nav commands so cd can follow a branch (#291)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/291)~~ (merged) 👈 - 🟣 ~~[feat(list): show which worktree holds each branch in list and status (#290)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/290)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(code): explain worktree collisions instead of leaking git's fatal (#289)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/289)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(code): keep a worktree-held branch instead of failing cleanup (#288)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/288)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(restack): preflight worktree-held branches and clear stale state (#287)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/287)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(stack): refuse an undo that would rewind branches held by worktrees (#286)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/286)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(code): add git::worktree_branches to detect branches held elsewhere (#285)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/285)~~ (merged) - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)
